question: Will in-person school classes be officially suspended in the city of Valencia, Spain on any day during October 15–16, 2026?

calls.reasoning: Reference class: Valencia City Council weather-driven class suspensions since Sep 2025 (Sep 29 2025 city-wide; ~Oct 12-13 2025 partial flood-zone schools; Oct 1-2 2026 city-wide) ≈ 3-4 episodes per autumn of ~1.5 school days, implying ~10-15% for a fixed 2-day window. Since Sep 2025 the council closes 19 flood-zone/pedanía schools even on ORANGE rain warnings, and a partial closure counts, which lowers the bar. But model forecasts 10 days out show mild (19-21C), partly cloudy to overcast weather for Oct 15-16 (30% rain chance) and no DANA signal, though skill at this range is low and warnings come only 1-3 days ahead. No human market found (harness found none on Polymarket/Manifold; Kalshi and bookmakers not searched by this run).
calls.dossier:
- Ajuntament de València policy (valencia.es, 15 Sep 2025): the city suspends classes under an AEMET ORANGE rain warning at 19 schools (7 in mapped flood-risk zones, 12 in rural pedanías Castellar-l'Oliveral, La Torre, Forn d'Alcedo), stricter than Generalitat guidance. A partial suspension counts for this question.
- 29 Sep 2025 (El Español, 28 Sep 2025): city-wide suspension in all Valencia schools after AEMET raised the warning from orange to red; CECOPAL emergency meeting.
- ~12-13 Oct 2025 (rtvc.es / officialpress): Valencia city suspended classes in flood-prone zones/DANA-affected neighbourhoods; 14 municipalities in total, ~78.7k students.
- 1-2 Oct 2026 (The Objective / Infobae, 1 Oct 2026): city closed all centres from 15:00 Thu 1 Oct through Fri 2 Oct under red warning (AEMET forecast up to 300 mm in <12h); Generalitat suspensions covered ~360k students in 104 municipalities.
- ValenciaExtra (early Oct 2026): rain expected to clear from the Comunitat by Mon 5 Oct; instability over Spain possibly persisting to mid-week.
- Automated long-range model sites (tiempo3 / accuweather, viewed 5 Oct 2026): Oct 12 moderate rain; Oct 13 overcast; Oct 14 sunny; Oct 15 partly cloudy 21/19C, ~30% rain chance; Oct 16 overcast 21/18C. These are low-skill forecasts at 10 days.
- AEMET torrential-rain warnings are typically issued only 1-3 days ahead; autumn is peak DANA season on the Valencian coast; question background cites a wetter-than-normal autumn signal.
- Status quo: no suspension (normal school days Thu 15 / Fri 16 Oct; Oct 9 and Oct 12 are holidays, both outside the window).
- Rough base rate: about 3-4 Valencia-city weather suspension episodes per autumn since Sep 2025 (counted from the instances above), each ~1-2 school days, over ~60 autumn school days (Sep-Nov). This is an unconditional rate, not conditioned on the current forecast.
- Resolves off official Ajuntament de València orders (CECOPAL) or Las Provincias/Levante-EMV reporting; Generalitat-only suspensions in other municipalities do not count; the motive must be weather.
- Event window: Oct 15 00:00 -> Oct 16 24:00 (local) per the criteria; as of 5 Oct 2026 the window has not started (0% elapsed).
- Searched but not found: any prediction market or bookmaker line (none on Polymarket/Manifold); any AEMET warning or official medium-range bulletin naming Oct 15-16.

Its standing protocol closes ~19 flood-zone and pedanía schools under an AEMET orange rain warning, which lowers the bar for YES. That gives a ~6-12% climatological chance for a fixed 2-school-day window in mid-October, peak DANA season. calls.reconciliation: The runs agree on the facts: the Sep 2025 protocol suspends ~19 schools under an orange warning, the city-wide closure on Oct 1-2 2026 was real, forecasts show no DANA signal for Oct 15-16, and no market exists. Differences were judgment only: Run 1 put the base rate a little higher at 3-4 episodes per autumn, while Runs 2 and 3 discounted it more for a benign 10-day outlook. No web access on this run, so no new evidence. I take the episode count as ~3 per autumn of ~1.5 days over ~60 school days, giving ~8-10% for the window, then apply a small downweight for the absence of any model signal plus a stabilizing Mediterranean. That lands at 7%.
